podcast.body: Jackie DeShannon originally wrote "Bette Davis Eyes" in the 1970s as a Big Band Pop song, before Kim Carnes transformed it into a synth rock hit. "A song written in the 70s by Jackie Dishanan as Big Band Pop."

podcast.body: Jackie DeShannon's 1974 deep cut, described as a "slap-happy piano pop ditty." This song was later famously transformed into a shimmering new wave hit by Kim Carnes. "this deep cut from 1974 by veteran singer-songwriter Jackie Dushanin, a slap-happy piano pop did he called Betty Davis Eyes."
